description: This file defines a sandbox policy for the 'metrics' component within the 'process_sandboxer' module of the 'cuttlefish' project. It constructs a sandbox2::PolicyBuilder with specific permissions, including directory and file access, network permissions, and certain syscalls, to isolate the 'metrics' process.

methods.name: MetricsPolicy
methods.description: Constructs and returns a sandbox2::PolicyBuilder object configured with permissions for the 'metrics' process, including directory, file, network, and syscall allowances.
